notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Fix:[/h2]

Fixed an issue where the story could not progress if the player investigated the tiger before investigating the chicken during the investigation in the hall before the debate in Chapter 4.
(Players who have already encountered this issue and saved their progress can investigate the karma line of the two chickens again to continue the story.)

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Optimization:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moved an important explanation about "Bodypaint" in Chapter 3 to a main storyline event that is guaranteed to trigger.
[*] Added a "sparkling" effect to certain main storyline investigation points that are easy to overlook.
[*] Optimized the event trigger for the Plate Puzzle in Chapter 5.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the game's physics detection to reduce the issue of the protagonist falling through the ground.
[*] Fixed various text errors and map display issues.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor would briefly appear when moving between rooms.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain settings might not save correctly.
[*] Fixed missing effects when consuming karmarines and adjusted their display in certain story scenes.
[*] Fixed untranslated UI elements in Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.
[*] Fixed an issue where illustrations might disappear when navigating the illustration gallery without using a mouse.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 4 where investigating the lobby in a specific sequence before a debate could cause character display errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Optimizations:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added automatic scene transitions in several story sections in Chapter 4 when appropriate conditions are met, minimizing unnecessary backtracking during Taiqing's alchemy tasks.
[*] Added a task reminder for the main storyline in Chapter 4 to prevent confusion between main and side quests.
[*] Reworked left joystick control for all UIs, making it more natural and reducing unintentional inputs and accidental touches.
[*] Optimized left joystick control experience for moving the circular cursor (applies to any interface requiring the use of a circular cursor, including severing lines, moving rooms, etc.).
[*] Enlarged the circular cursor in the Move Room interface for better visibility.
[*] Adjusted the performance of a severing-lines scene in the final chapter to avoid misleading player actions.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some text errors in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed incorrect text highlight in Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed an issue where character names in the dialogue record might not display correctly in certain resolutions in Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed an issue where the last hint might not display fully in certain resolutions in English and Japanese versions.
[*] Fixed a scene display error at the end of Chapter 4.
[*] Fixed an issue during the on-site investigation in Chapter 2, where clues could be recorded prematurely in certain investigative sequences.
[*] Fixed a UI texture error in the final chapter of the Traditional Chinese version.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Art Book appreciation section where keyboard and controller inputs couldn't zoom in on images.
[*] Fixed an issue whereGran Miao didn't appear during a certain story section in Chapter 2.
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting options too quickly in the  Teller Fon and Move Room interface could lead to incorrect choices.
[*] Adjusted the timing for returning Thunder room in Chapter 3 to avoid story logic problems.
[*] Fixed the collision mechanism in the ring-toss mini-game to reduce instances where it gets stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added 4K resolution option in settings.
[*] Introduced a skip feature for the final multi-room puzzle after a certain number of attempts or amount of time.
[/olist]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Corrected some text errors in various languages.
[*] Fixed display errors in chapter title animations for Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.
[*] Resolved the issue where Gran Miao could still be interacted with after disappearing.
[*] Fixed a potential freeze during the Great Buddha challenge.
[*] Adjusted some misleading button prompt icons.
[*] Improved collision detection for traversing paintings, making it more obvious.
[*] Fixed a bug where Taiqing could destroy Generall Tso’s room door.
[*] Replaced the handwritten font for Traditional Chinese, addressing missing character issues.
[*] Corrected the handwritten font used for the final wall hints in English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Fixed the issue where the character would switch incorrectly during subsequent ring game with Taiqing (the first switch works as intended).
[*] Resolved an issue where resetting to default settings would revert resolution and frame rate.
[*] Fixed UI and texture errors in the English language setting.
[/olist]
